SI section 6 "Caco-2 permeability assay" verbatim (`ja3c03886_si_001.pdf`): "FaSSIF/HBSS buffer (pH 6.0) containing the compound and 1% DMSO was added to the Apical side, and HBSS buffer containing 4% BSA (pH 7.4) was added to the Basal side, and membrane permeability assays were initiated... samples on the Basal side were collected, and the amount of compound was determined by LC-MS". Identical Chugai protocol to 2023_Ohta and 2018_CHUGAI. Clean A→B.

Paper Supplementary Tables 4+6 report A→B and B→A Papp per compound (10, 10a-f and 13, 13a-f). For each measurable Ghosh entry the CycPeptMPDB-stored Caco2 value matches log10((AB+BA)/2) exactly to two decimals (e.g. ID 7452 compound 10: paper AB=0.8 and BA=12.5 ×10⁻⁶ cm/s → log10(6.65 ×10⁻⁶) = -5.18, DB stores -5.18; same exact match across 10a, 10c, 10e, 10f). The 7 compound-13 series rows are BLOD because both AB and BA were 0 in the paper. So CycPeptMPDB applied the AB+BA arithmetic mean convention to Ghosh data despite not labeling it that way in the bibliography snapshot — same convention as Le Roux/Comeau/Marelli/Lee-2021/Zaretsky.

Main text methods: "The Caco-2 assay was performed by Axcelead Drug Discovery Partners, Inc. (Kanagawa, Japan)." SI (`jm2c00010_si_001.pdf`) inspected: Caco-2 appears once as a column header in a results table; no methods section for Caco-2 (only PAMPA methods are described). Direction therefore unconfirmed in both main text and SI.

Identical Chugai protocol to Ohta and Tanada. Clean A→B.
